title: Trace: what the engine recorded on every physics tick of one replay (never shown to the fixer)
description: Written by the Godot harness (harness/godot/expectrail_harness.gd) and the Unity harness (harness/unity/package). World coordinates are pixels with y pointing down. Readers ignore fields they do not know, so a field added here must stay optional. Not listed in expectrail.contracts.KINDS (that file is frozen by discovery/freeze.json); validate with expectrail.contracts.validate(doc, 'trace').

groundSources.description: Added Nov 13, 2026 by the Godot harness: where a row's ground may come from. tiles: the level has tile layers; bodies: how many of its bodies count as platforms (StaticBody2D, AnimatableBody2D and CharacterBody2D other than the player, enemies and projectiles).

levelSurfaces.description: Every solid surface of the level as a polygon of [x, y] world points.

levelArt.description: Where the level's floor is drawn: per world column from x0, the [top, bottom] runs that are drawn.

ground.description: World y of the level surface under the player, from the level's geometry (tiles, and since Nov 13, 2026 the authored collision of its platforms), never from the player's own collider.

groundFrom.description: Added Nov 13, 2026 by the Godot harness, with ground: whether the surface is a tile's or a platform body's.

body.description: Added Nov 12, 2026 by the Godot harness: the world box [left, top, right, bottom] of the player's own collision in this tick (its collision shapes and polygons that are not disabled, as they stand in the world: scaled, mirrored). How big the engine says the player is, and where. Left out when the player has no collision to measure; a reader never guesses one.

view.description: [xx, xy, yx, yy, ox, oy]: a world point (x, y) lands at (xx*x + yx*y + ox, xy*x + yy*y + oy) in frame pixels. It is the camera of the frame drawn before this row's tick; readers take the next row's view for this tick's frame (agents/observations.py, _view_at).

objects.description: Added Nov 9 for the Unity harness (the Godot harness does not write it): every tracked object as the engine placed it in this row's own frame (the frame of this tick, not the view convention above).

id.description: The object's hierarchy path; a later object on a path already used gets #2, #3 ... in the order the recorder first saw them.

box.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] in frame pixels, y down, from the renderer's bounds; null when the object has no renderer.

visible.description: Active, its renderer enabled, a sprite to draw, alpha above 0 and its bounds inside the camera's frustum.
